attributes.fi_description: The intended estimator has limited sensitivity or incomplete scenario coverage for recognizing an actual loss of validated operating capability. Fresh, valid channel reports can overestimate capability because image-quality and environmental proxies do not cover every target-dependent limitation. Element origin: ComputeUnit.monitor, allocated to Fusion using modality-specific assessments from CameraAcquisition, InfraredAcquisition and LidarAcquisition; the resulting capability is consumed by TigerDetectionApp. Correct execution of this estimator does not establish complete monitoring coverage.

The learned classifier representation does not generalize reliably to some physically valid animal poses despite correct execution. Element origin: SysML ScanForTiger (ComputeUnit.scan), allocated to TigerDetectionApp after fusion.

The functioning RGB, lidar and LWIR channels can jointly provide too little discriminating information for the specified detection target under certain combinations of environment and target geometry. The sensing specification and validated performance boundary do not provide sufficient coverage of those combinations. This is a system sensing-capability limitation; it does not assert that usable information is discarded by fusion. All three channels remain required.
The way multiple sensing modalities are fused has limitations (e.g. weighting, timing alignment, conflict resolution) that degrade the fused result relative to the individual channels.

The intended thermal perception function cannot reliably separate target and background when their thermal contrast is small. Element origin: the LWIR sensing/perception chain, with acquisition and contrast estimates allocated to InfraredAcquisition. A valid contrast estimate does not prove recognition for every target.

attributes.has_name: Insufficient sensing diversity for visually concealed targets
attributes.fi_description: With RGB and lidar alone, visible appearance and geometric returns may not provide enough discriminating information for a stationary, camouflaged or partly concealed tiger. The omission of a complementary thermal observation is a specification insufficiency, not a sensor failure. The resulting runtime measure adds LWIR acquisition and thermal evidence evaluation to the current sensing and perception chain.

The correctly functioning sensing chain cannot resolve sufficient target features at a small angular or apparent image size. Element origin: the visible camera sensing chain; RGB acquisition is allocated to CameraAcquisition. Low apparent target size can remain limiting despite a valid status report.
